phase_3_alert_dispatcher.fifo_eviction: unit-tested only — live test blocked by cooldown dedup (ALERT_COOLDOWN_SEC=0 → 300s default)
phase_3_alert_dispatcher.finding_cooldown_zero: ALERT_COOLDOWN_SEC=0 falls back to 300s default (dispatcher.go:36: if cfg.CooldownSec <= 0). Should support 0 as 'no cooldown'.

phase_4_degraded.healthz_design_note: /healthz does nil checks only (lightweight liveness) — driver object persists when Neo4j is down, so healthz stays 'ok'. /readyz correctly detects unhealthy via live VerifyConnectivity.
phase_4_degraded.prober_alert_note: SetAlertCallback() never called on prober in serve.go — wiring gap #2
phase_4_degraded.cb_alert_detail: Circuit breaker openai-intent opened during Neo4j disruption — CB→alert wiring confirmed live

phase_6_overflow.verdict: PARTIAL — FIFO eviction works, alert callback not wired
phase_6_overflow.alert_callback_note: SetAlertCallback() never called on LLM writer in serve.go or server.go — wiring gap #1
phase_6_overflow.note: 46 records from ~50 LLM requests suggests FIFO eviction is active (buffer capped at 5)

phase_7_hooks.bug_found: timeout command not available on macOS — broke jq alert parsing in both hooks
phase_7_hooks.bug_fix: Removed 'timeout 2' wrapper from jq calls in session-start.sh:64 and prompt-context.sh:52

specs: healthz_enhanced.uats.json (8 assertions: status, checks exists/type, neo4j/cb/tsdb keys)

findings.title: ALERT_COOLDOWN_SEC=0 treated as 300s default
findings.detail: if cfg.CooldownSec <= 0 { cfg.CooldownSec = 300 } — 0 should mean 'no cooldown', not 'use default'
findings.fix: Change to < 0 or add explicit sentinel value

findings.title: Health prober SetAlertCallback not wired
findings.detail: Prober detects Neo4j/TSDB transitions but SetAlertCallback() is never called — no alert fires on health transitions
findings.fix: Wire prober.SetAlertCallback → alertDispatcher.SendAlert in serve.go after NewServer (needs alertDispatcher reference)

findings.title: TSDB LLM writer SetAlertCallback not wired
findings.detail: LLM writer has FIFO eviction and overflow counter but SetAlertCallback() never called — overflow alert never fires
findings.fix: Wire earlyLLMWriter.SetAlertCallback → alertDispatcher.SendAlert in serve.go after NewServer

findings.title: macOS timeout command missing breaks alert hooks
findings.detail: timeout is GNU coreutils, not available on macOS. Causes jq alert parsing to fail silently (|| echo 0), suppressing all alert banners.
findings.fix: FIXED — removed timeout 2 wrapper from jq calls

verdict_detail: Core features work correctly. Alert dispatcher, enhanced healthz, UATS specs, LLM retry config, hook alert delivery (after fix) all verified. Three wiring gaps (F-001 to F-003) prevent full alert pipeline operation but are non-blocking. One bug (F-004) fixed during testing.
